description: This source file defines the AWS SchedulerClient class, which extends AwsClient, and includes method annotations for interacting with the Amazon EventBridge Scheduler service, such as creating, deleting, retrieving, listing schedules and schedule groups, and managing resource tags.

classes.name: SchedulerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon EventBridge Scheduler service, providing methods for managing schedules and schedule groups.

methods.name: createSchedule
methods.description: Creates a new schedule in the Amazon EventBridge Scheduler service.

methods.name: createScheduleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new schedule, returning a promise.

methods.name: createScheduleGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new schedule group.

methods.name: getSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific schedule.

methods.name: getScheduleGroup
methods.description: Fetches details of a schedule group.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
